notes: Root-key split: this root (יצר, "to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress") is spelled identically to the existing יצר "to form" (H3335, "to mould into a form; especially as a potter") but is a wholly separate historical root/meaning, same convention as חפר¹/² and גאל¹/². This root (the lower Strong's number) is יצר¹; H3335 has been retroactively relabeled יצר² (no other field touched).

Hiphil is an attested-but-unrequested stem beyond the requested qal -- its sole citation (Neh.9.27, "and thou gavest them into the hand of their enemies, who distressed them") is the natural causative of qal's "be in distress" (cause distress = oppress). Included.
